title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Reports 2023 First Quarter Results
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended March 31, 2023. For the three months ended March 31, 2023 and 2022, Net Income was $1.1 million, or $0.02 per diluted share, compared to Net Income of $9.5 million, or $0.14 per diluted share, respectively.
